projects.name: Fremont facility expansion
projects.quote: We are in the process of expanding our annual production capacity run rate at our Fremont facility from 1 gigawatt to 2 gigawatts and expect to complete the expansion by the end of 2026.

projects.name: AEP 1 GW supply agreement
projects.quote: We entered into multiple agreements with utilities in 2024, including a landmark 1 GW supply agreement with American Electric Power (AEP) that included a 100 MW order in 2024.
